div.div: لَا نَزْرٌ وَلَا هَذْرٌ Not little nor much: (TA:) or not scanty, so as to indicate impotence, nor much and corrupt: said of the speech of Mohammad. (K, art. نزر.) [See هَذَرٌ, from which it is altered to assimilate it in form to نَزْرٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
